description: Defines the dl_csi_rs_pdu_builder class, a builder for configuring CSI-RS PDU parameters in a 5G NR protocol stack, with methods to set various PDU parameters according to SCF-222 v4.0 section 3.4.2.3.

classes.name: dl_csi_rs_pdu_builder
classes.description: A builder class for configuring CSI-RS PDU parameters.

methods.name: set_csi_resource_config_parameters
methods.description: Sets resource configuration parameters for the CSI-RS PDU.

methods.name: set_frequency_domain_parameters
methods.description: Sets frequency domain parameters for the CSI-RS PDU.

methods.name: set_time_domain_parameters
methods.description: Sets time domain parameters for the CSI-RS PDU.

methods.name: set_resource_block_parameters
methods.description: Sets resource block parameters for the CSI-RS PDU.

methods.name: set_bwp_parameters
methods.description: Sets BWP (Bandwidth Part) parameters for the CSI-RS PDU.

methods.name: set_tx_power_info_parameters
methods.description: Sets transmission power information parameters for the CSI-RS PDU.
